Message.Content: 03/10/2026 09:15-Bus services 170 and 170X have been diverted from Woodlands Road to ply along Woodlands Ave 3 and Woodlands Centre Road in the Woodlands Direction, due to heavy traffic entering Woodlands Checkpoint.

05:00-SK-Planned Service Adjustments. Sengkang West LRT Inner Loop service (i.e. direction of STC Sengkang towards SW1 Cheng Lim) will resume on 4 Oct 2026. Peak-hours shuttle bus services will end after 2 Oct 2026.
